title: AN LLM-BASED DELPHI STUDY TO PREDICT GENAI EVOLUTION

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of the LLM-generated Delphi responses, observing a strong predominance of positive, forward-looking perspectives on Generative AI while existential risks and critical minority perspectives were largely omitted.

Assigning diverse, randomized personas (including varying nationalities, educational backgrounds, and fields of expertise) to LLM agents to simulate panel heterogeneity and evaluate if this mitigates the homogeneous consensus-building typically found in human-driven Delphi studies.
